newsitem.title: BELGIUM: BABY JESUS FACES EVICTION FROM FLEMISH HEATH.
newsitem.headline: BABY JESUS FACES EVICTION FROM FLEMISH HEATH.

text.p: Baby Jesus and his parents may have to spend Christmas without a roof over their heads because the stable housing them on a heath in Flanders lacks planning permission, Belgian newspaper De Standaard said on Friday.
Seeking a court injunction, the Flemish region wants the pageant in the Brechtse Heide, eastern Belgium, torn down because it was built illegally in a nature reserve.
The region is also concerned about large numbers of visitors attracted to the site, in place since 1992, trampling the flora and disturbing the fauna.
The court is to rule on the injunction on December 24.
